decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a variety of backpack styles including hydration packs, baseball-specific bags, slings, and packable daypacks. The consideration set was chosen based on high ratings and diverse functionality. I ultimately selected the HIKPRO 20L (prod_backpacks_006) as the final purchase because it maintains a high 4.7-star rating across nearly 3,000 reviews, indicating consistent quality and durability. At $17.99, it offers the best value for a water-resistant, lightweight backpack that is versatile enough for both travel and daily use, outperforming the ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_099) on review volume and the Mubasel (prod_backpacks_132) on general utility and price.
